requirements.title: Boundary and owned authority
requirements.statement: Keep represented actor state, EDI policy, intended action, command completion and independently measured effect separate.
requirements.rationale: A modeled goal or model-admission decision cannot authorize the software.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Explicit actor information mask
requirements.statement: Retain only explicit attributed data with pinned actor/model/evidence refs, availability/receipt/perception cuts and clock assumptions.
requirements.rationale: Actors must not automatically inherit the analyst's entire model or future evidence.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Owned purpose and original standards
requirements.statement: Retain immutable purpose/standards history and distinguish fixed action, parameter change, policy amendment and explicit goal version change.
requirements.rationale: Changing a goal is different from meeting its original standard.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Proposal and explicit adoption
requirements.statement: Bootstrap and later policy changes require separate adopt/reject/defer decisions and optimistic base revision; terminal decisions are immutable.
requirements.rationale: Fallible advice must not install itself or silently rebase.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Finite named grants
requirements.statement: Check exact operation/origin/record/item/time scope against a named current grant and preserve refusal.
requirements.rationale: A broad mission or an access request does not supply source/action authority.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Research grammar and operator boundary
requirements.statement: Allow only installed internal read adapters; keep external actuation/acquisition and direct C5 dispatch unavailable; expose operator decisions only to trusted local SDK/CLI.
requirements.rationale: Explicitly bounded permissions must be enforceable without interpreting model prose.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Dispatch-time authorization integrity
requirements.statement: Recheck policy adoption hash/revision, grant and expiry at dispatch and after writer-lock acquisition, with cooperative execution fences.
requirements.rationale: An earlier authorization may have expired or been superseded before work starts.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Durable single-use command
requirements.statement: Commit exact command intent and reserved completion capacity before invoking a read; consume each decision once and allow one unresolved workspace command.
requirements.rationale: Restart/duplicate delivery must not turn into an untracked repeated invocation.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Receipt and reconciliation integrity
requirements.statement: Return original retry status, preserve unresolved completion, reconcile explicitly from an archived report, and reject late terminal overwrite.
requirements.rationale: Missing acknowledgement is not proof of failure or permission for automatic retry.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Original report and generated lineage
requirements.statement: Stage exact original UTF-8 report capture and retain its C1 receipt; mark local reports generated and distinct from measured effects.
requirements.rationale: Capturing an account preserves its provenance without making it independent corroboration.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Standing access and denial lifecycle
requirements.statement: Reuse current covering grants; coalesce exact needs; retain denial/defer/expiry; leave notification/acquisition to C0/C1.
requirements.rationale: Exploration should reuse permission and avoid repeated unchanged access prompts.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Candidate-only modeled policy proposals
requirements.statement: Stage exact attributed candidate C3 puts and original commit receipts without admission, hidden rebase, operational adoption or claimed domain effects.
requirements.rationale: Model revision and actual system/policy transition have different owners and evidence.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Finite operating envelope
requirements.statement: Bound requests, state, selections, result bytes, cooperative work, writer waits and disk reserve; retain original prepaid completion allowances.
requirements.rationale: Finite resources must fail explicitly without consuming completion capacity needed by admitted work.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Scoped native interfaces and isolation
requirements.statement: Use restricted C0/C1/C3 ports and seven distinct owner database scopes; preserve all 56 lane dispositions and no direct C4/C5/C6 action bypass.
requirements.rationale: Adding a capability must not bypass admission or stall source recording behind a new owner.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Versioned immutable audit selections
requirements.statement: Retain request fingerprints, content hashes, original outcomes, fixed-position selections and unsupported-version errors.
requirements.rationale: Long-lived review requires stable identity/time and explicit unavailable history.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.

requirements.title: Trace and honest qualification
requirements.statement: Document assumptions, decisions, alternatives, interfaces, source checks and unrun cases without promoting C6/C7 or original wider requirements to accepted.
requirements.rationale: Source structure and plausible reasoning do not establish scientific intelligence, usefulness, speed or HA.
requirements.acceptance: At a future pinned configuration, the linked cases must demonstrate this scoped behavior and its refusal/recovery counterexamples; source checks alone do not satisfy it.
